item.title: 12 killed, 309 wounded in missile attack on Riyadh airport
item.description: At least 12 people killed and 309 wounded in a missile attack on Riyadh's airport, believed to have been carried out by the Houthis.

item.title: Report: US pressured Israel to strike Iran before elections
item.description: Trump administration urged Israel to launch a strike against Iran amid concerns over Tehran's military buildup, asking Israel to bear political risks ahead of elections, journalist Ben Caspit reports.

item.title: IDF: No unusual findings on Lebanon border
item.description:
IDF: Following the sirens sounded at 19:57 in Arab al-Aramshe, IDF surveillance identified an unknown aerial subject on the border with Lebanon.
IDF soldiers are continuing to search the area, and until now, no suspicious findings were located. There are currently no special instructions for the home front.

item.title: Sderot Yeshiva: Three years, two Simchat Torah celebrations
item.description: Moving video contrasts Simchat Torah at Sderot Yeshiva just hours after the October 7 massacre, with students singing under armed guard, and this year's celebrations filled with dancing and joy. Watch.

item.title: Man seriously wounded after accident gunfire
item.description: Man, 28, seriously wounded in Yavne after gun allegedly discharged from legally owned firearm; police investigate.

item.title: To those who carry our grief and refuse to surrender our joy
item.description: Hatred has consequences, but sometimes, the young Jew they hoped to intimidate becomes the young Jew organising the next Shabbat dinner. Sometimes, the identity they hoped to weaken becomes the source of a person’s strength. Sometimes, our children lift a Torah above their heads and dance. Op-ed.

item.description: Israel providing drinking water, essential food supplies, to communities affected by Panama earthquake, following instructions from Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar.

item.title: The Eternity of Israel
item.description: Our ability to stand against the attacks of terror, falsehood, and wickedness of our Muslim enemies and those who do their bidding lies in the fundamental and basic understanding of the first Rashi of Breishit that “He declared the power of His deeds to His people."

item.title: Between humans, lions, and hyenas
item.description: The humanity of animals and the barbarity of man. Opinion.

item.title: Joint List offers to back any government that ousts Netanyahu
item.description: Joint List chairman Yousef Jabareen says party prepared to support any government that replaces Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but demands progress toward Palestinian state.

item.description: The British boycott Israeli products for false claims of "settler violence, but their policies include the turning of a blind eye to PA glorification of real, proven Arab terrorism. Opinion.

item.title: Panama rocked by 7.7 magnitude earthquake
item.description: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck Panama on Friday, October 9, causing widespread damage to buildings and infrastructure, injuring at least 27 people and prompting evacuations across the country.

item.title: Gantz refuses to quit Knesset race: 'I'm running until the end'
item.description: Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz rejects calls to withdraw from elections, dismissing claims of wasted votes.

item.title: Israel reveals codename for plane hijacking protocol
item.description: Israel has revealed the name of the IDF's emergency protocol for a civilian aircraft hijacking, used during the Flydubai incident.

item.title: IDF strikes Hamas Nukhba gathering
item.description: Israeli airstrikes eliminate several Hamas Nukhba terrorists gathered in Gaza City, senior Islamic Jihad anti-tank commander in northern Gaza, amid continued ceasefire violations.

item.title: Herzog to heroic Flydubai pilot: You are forever part of Israel's history
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog invites Captain Smit Machchhar to Jerusalem, pledges to honor him with presidential award once he recovers.

item.title: Historic first: Israeli Air Force joins Morocco airshow
item.description: Israeli Air Force delegation participates in Marrakech Airshow for the first time since the Abraham Accords, meeting Moroccan military officials to strengthen defense ties and cooperation.

item.title: IDF launches interceptor towards suspicious target in southern Lebanon
item.description:
IDF: A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a suspicious aerial target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon. The interception results are under review.
No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

item.title: IDF eliminates two terrorists in Gaza, including October 7 attacker
item.description: IDF, Shin Bet, eliminates Islamic Jihad commander who infiltrated Israel on October 7, Hamas Nukhba terrorist in separate strikes in Khan Yunis.

item.title: Shabbat Shalom!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 18:49 Jerusalem time.
Shabbat Shalom!

item.title: Ofer Winter: Bibi can go jump in a lake
item.description:
Ofer Winter addresses the possibility of joining a Netanyahu-led government, makes clear he will not compromise on his demands: "I don't work for any individual."
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: UK Green leader won't say if Israel has a right to exist
item.description:
UK Green Party leader Zack Polanski avoids answering whether Israel has a right to exist, while distancing himself from a party motion declaring Zionism racist.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Trump confirms Katie Zacharia as new White House press secretary
item.description:
US President Donald Trump confirmed on Friday that he has appointed Katie Zacharia as the next White House press secretary, replacing Karoline Leavitt, who left the position at the end of August.
Announcing the appointment on Truth Social, Trump praised Zacharia’s communications experience and longstanding support for his campaigns.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)
